name: Carpet on Stairs and Fall Safety in Older Homes
title-tag: Carpet on Stairs for Fall Safety | North Bend Installer
meta-description: Carpeting a bare wood staircase is the best fall-safety upgrade an older home can make — if the spec is right. Pile height, pad, runner vs full wrap, honestly.
post-summary: April 1, 2027 · Carpeting a bare wood staircase is the single most effective fall-safety upgrade most older homes can make — traction, readable tread edges, and a softer landing when falls happen anyway. But the spec matters: low dense pile over firm pad, wrapped nosings, and deep plush is actively unstable. Runner vs full wrap, and the aging-in-place case.
